Dare to explore on behalf of U.S. and U.K. military veterans by purchasing the Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) Navigator: Tracer Pack for Call of Duty®: Black Ops 7 and Call of Duty: Warzone™. Inspired by and created in close collaboration with U.S. Navy SEAL veteran and retired NASA astronaut, CAPT Chris Cassidy, (USN, ret.), this pack honors his military career journey from sea to space. The Endowment pack includes two operators, two weapon blueprints, and more.

description:
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10015602

Bow before death with a new, free update for Death Howl, a unique soulslike deck-builder.

With this new content comes Rebirth Mode, which elevates the challenge even further with reimagined and stronger enemies, reshaped cards, and revamped battles. And for the fittest, there is Custom Mode, which lets you tweak the challenge even further, meddling with levels of Ro's and enemy health, the amount of cards you can have in your hand, and more.

The Rebirth update is now live.
